purpose: Qualify a thin Ark text-embedding provider substitution while preserving ReasoningBank cosine ranking, cached case embeddings, stable descending sort, and top-1 retrieval.
probes: one batch containing duplicate text A, duplicate text A, and distinct text B
one repeated request for text A

decision_rule.pass: Both requests succeed; provider identity is stable and nonempty; every vector has one positive stable dimension and finite values; duplicate vectors match exactly within and across requests; the distinct text differs; self cosine is one; usage is present.
decision_rule.fail: Any request, identity, dimension, finiteness, duplicate consistency, distinctness, cosine, or usage check fails.

retrieval_invariants.ranking: descending score with stable input-order tie break
